# North Seattle Dispatch

> The North Seattle Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Seattle, WA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in North Seattle](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [North Seattle news](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/news/): every story, newest first
- [Reader asked](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/asked/): readers' questions answered from the public record
- [Standards](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Lake City](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/lake-city/): The business district along Lake City Way NE around NE 125th Street, with the Lake City community center, the library and Albert Davis Park.
- [Cedar Park](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/cedar-park/): The hillside north of Matthews Beach between Lake City Way NE and the Burke-Gilman Trail, looking out over Lake Washington.
- [Matthews Beach](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/matthews-beach/): Matthews Beach Park on Lake Washington, the Burke-Gilman Trail and the mouth of Thornton Creek.
- [Meadowbrook](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/meadowbrook/): Meadowbrook Pond, the Meadowbrook community center and pool, and the Thornton Creek corridor along 35th Avenue NE.
- [Pinehurst](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/pinehurst/): Along 15th Avenue NE between Northgate and Lake City, with the Jackson Park golf course and its perimeter trail.
- [Northgate](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/northgate/): Northgate Station, the pedestrian bridge over I-5 to North Seattle College, the redeveloped mall site and Hubbard Homestead Park.
- [Haller Lake](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/haller-lake/): The lake itself and the streets around it west of I-5, with Northacres Park and Northgate to the south.
- [Bitter Lake](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/bitter-lake/): Bitter Lake with its playfield and community center, and the Aurora Avenue North corridor along the east side.
- [Broadview](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/broadview/): The northwest corner of the city above Puget Sound, with Carkeek Park, the Piper's Creek trails and Greenwood Avenue North.
- [North Beach / Blue Ridge](https://www.northseattledispatch.com/north-beach-blue-ridge/): The bluff above Puget Sound between Golden Gardens and Carkeek Park, looking west to the Olympics.
